consent.text: By tapping “{{action}}” you agree to our <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and confirm you have read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>, including that SheOut is women only and that a government ID is reviewed by a person before your first trip.

legal.englishOnly: This document is available in English only for now. A translated version is being prepared.

language.title: Language
language.subtitle: Choose the language for SheOut. You can change it any time from the menu.
language.saveError: Changed on this phone. We could not save it to your account - it will try again next time.

cancelDialog.title: Why are you cancelling?
cancelDialog.message: This helps us understand what went wrong. Your answer is not shown to the other person.

rating.title: How was your trip?
rating.message: Your rating is private. It is never shown to the other person, and it is not attached to your name.
rating.commentPlaceholder: What was it like travelling with {{who}}?
rating.label: Rating

chat.emptyOpen: No messages yet. Say hello, or send {{who}} a landmark to look for.
chat.emptyClosed: No messages were sent on this trip.

rider.title: Turn on notifications
rider.body: Know the moment your partner accepts, when she is arriving, and when support replies - even with SheOut closed.

partner.title: Turn on trip alerts
partner.body: New trip requests only last 15 seconds. With alerts on, your phone rings and vibrates for each one, even when SheOut is closed.

push.blocked: Notifications are blocked for SheOut in this browser. Allow them in the site settings to get alerts on this device.
push.unsupported: This browser cannot show SheOut notifications. On an iPhone, add SheOut to your Home Screen first.
push.off: Notifications are off on this device. Everything still appears here.

inbox.emptyMessage: Updates about your trips and account will appear here.

tickets.filteredEmptyMessage: Your tickets are still here. Clear the filters to see them all.
tickets.emptyMessage: When you raise an issue, it appears here with every reply from support.

thread.placeholder: Add more detail or reply to support

raiseIssue.subject: Subject
raiseIssue.subjectPlaceholder: e.g. Charged twice for one trip
raiseIssue.descriptionPlaceholder: Tell us as much as you can - when, where, and what you would like us to do.

privacy.heading: Privacy & Data
privacy.downloadSub: A copy of everything SheOut holds about you
privacy.grievancePending: Contact details are being set up - use Help & Support meanwhile
privacy.deleteSub: Close your account and remove your personal details
privacy.permanent: This permanently closes your account. There is no way to undo it.
privacy.downloadError: Could not download your data. Try again.
privacy.deleteError: Could not delete your account. Try again.

explain.closed: Your account is closed straight away: you are signed out everywhere and cannot sign back in to it.
explain.removedDriver: You go offline permanently and stop receiving trips. Your name, vehicle registration, profile photo and ID documents are removed - the photo and documents are deleted from storage, not just hidden.
explain.removedRider: Your name, saved addresses, emergency contacts and ID documents are removed - the documents are deleted from storage, not just hidden.
explain.messages: Your messages are deleted, except on a trip with an open support dispute, where they are kept as "[deleted]".
explain.kept: Completed trips and payments are kept for the period Indian tax and dispute rules require, but with your name shown as "Deleted User" and your phone number removed.
explain.final: This cannot be undone. Signing in with the same number later starts a new, empty account.
